method.cost: Each new arm adds one bias-free hidden-by-hidden projection: 2304 weights at the default hidden width of 48 and O(batch × length × hidden²) projection work. Runtime is unmeasured; host costing must confirm the full frozen protocol fits the proposed budget.
method.mechanism: Add a zero-initialized, bias-free Linear(hidden, hidden) residual inside encode_sequence after the incumbent blend. The candidate projects the L2-normalized current item embedding, scaled by sqrt(hidden); the matched control projects the L2-normalized current post-encoder state with the same scaling. Apply the same fixed 0.1 × tanh transform and valid-token mask in both arms. This contrasts a direct item-identity path with equal projection capacity applied to an existing representation.
